title: Caramel Apple Martini Pudding Shots
description: This adults-only caramel apple pudding shot recipe features instant pudding and whipped topping with apple Schnapps, butterscotch Schnapps, and vodka.
ingredients: 1 (3.4 ounce) package butterscotch instant pudding mix
0.5 cup sour apple schnapps (such as DeKuyper® Sour Apple Pucker ®)
2 tablespoons butterscotch schnapps (such as DeKuyper® Buttershots®)
1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping (such as Cool Whip®), thawed

steps.text: Beat milk and pudding mix together in a large bowl until smooth; stir in apple Schnapps, butterscotch Schnapps, and vodka until blended. Fold in whipped topping until incorporated.
Divide mixture among 12 shot glasses or disposable shot cups. Freeze until ready to serve.
